# Alisa Tech Studio

> Alisa Tech Studio builds innovative, high-performance Flutter mobile applications, modern web software, and custom digital experiences for iOS, Android, and the web.

Alisa Tech Studio specializes in cross-platform mobile engineering, cognitive puzzle games, educational language learning tools, community reporting platforms, and privacy-first digital applications. We craft intuitive user interfaces, architect buttery 120 FPS rendering pipelines, and partner with startups and organizations to build custom software.

## Core Pages

- [Home](https://alisatechstudio.online/): Main portal showcasing our software portfolio, development capabilities, Flutter expertise, and company overview.
- [About Us](https://alisatechstudio.online/about.html): Our engineering philosophy, software architecture standards, and development team background.
- [Contact](https://alisatechstudio.online/contact.html): Inquiries, custom software partnerships, support desk, and user feedback channels (alisatechstudio@gmail.com).
- [Knowledge Hub & Articles](https://alisatechstudio.online/articles.html): In-depth engineering tutorials, technical guides, puzzle strategies, and language learning research.

## Engineering & Knowledge Guides

- [Mastering Flutter Performance](https://alisatechstudio.online/articles/flutter-mobile-app-performance.html): In-depth guide detailing widget rebuilding optimizations, isolate concurrency, memory management, and profiling tools for achieving 120 FPS on iOS and Android.
- [Complete Sudoku Strategy Guide](https://alisatechstudio.online/articles/sudoku-mastery-guide.html): Comprehensive cognitive guide covering beginner to advanced Sudoku techniques (Naked Singles, Hidden Pairs, X-Wing, Box-Line Reductions) and brain health benefits.
- [Accelerated Language Acquisition Framework](https://alisatechstudio.online/articles/effective-language-learning.html): Educational blueprint exploring Spaced Repetition Systems (SRS), comprehensible input, and CEFR progression for mastering German and Italian.
- [Mobile App Security & Privacy Guide](https://alisatechstudio.online/articles/mobile-app-security-privacy.html): Actionable handbook on Apple App Tracking Transparency (ATT), Android Privacy Sandbox, secure storage, and ethical user tracking.
